independent_verification_rules: A fresh verifier session MUST independently reopen the original native session record from the recorded native session store and locator.
The verifier MUST independently locate the same session ID and exact ordered user-event pair.
The verifier MUST recompute both native event-record hashes, both literal UTF-8 hashes, and transcript_prefix_sha256_through_invocation.
The verifier MUST prove the source record prefix through invocation is byte-identical to the materializer evidence.
If the native source record is unavailable, has a changed prefix, or yields zero/multiple matching sessions/events, provenance verification FAILS.
BSO_EQ_CODEX_NATIVE_SESSION_USER_EVENT_P.native_user_role_assertion_rule: For each event, the parser MUST record the exact native field path and exact native value whose semantics identify the record as a USER-originated message. The accepted parser MAY recognize native Codex representations such as a role field equal to user or a native user_message event type, but it MUST NOT infer user origin merely from message text.
BSO_EQ_CODEX_NATIVE_SESSION_USER_EVENT_P.purpose: Operationally prove that exact acceptance/authorization text entered through the native Codex user-message channel in one native local Codex session record.
session_discovery_algorithm: Determine candidate native Codex session-store roots from runtime-native Codex configuration/state (for example an exposed CODEX_HOME and/or the native default session store), without accepting a user-supplied arbitrary directory as the authority substrate.
Enumerate native session/rollout records read-only and record native_session_candidate_file_count.
Parse records without modifying them and require a native session identifier sourced from metadata in the same record.
Find exact UTF-8 user-message content equal to the supplied re-attestation literal and exact UTF-8 user-message content equal to the supplied invocation literal.
Require the re-attestation event to be user-originated according to an explicit native role/type assertion and require exact literal hash equality.
Require the invocation event to be user-originated according to an explicit native role/type assertion, exact literal hash equality, and a strictly greater event ordinal in the same native session.
Require exactly one re-attestation match in that session and exactly one qualifying invocation match after it.

Compute transcript_prefix_sha256_through_invocation over the exact native session-record bytes from the file start through and including the complete native record that contains the invocation event, including its terminating record delimiter when the native format uses one.

Record the whole native source-file SHA256 and byte size at capture for audit; independent verification relies on the immutable prefix hash through invocation so later append-only assistant/tool records do not invalidate the provenance.
Fail closed if parsing, user-role attribution, event ordering, uniqueness, or prefix byte boundaries are ambiguous.
trust_scope: The native Codex session/rollout store is treated as the operational authority for message-channel role attribution.
The materializer and verifier are contractually prohibited from creating, editing, rewriting, truncating, or replacing the source native session/rollout record.
This mode distinguishes native user-channel input from model-originated output for project governance; it does not assert legal identity or cryptographic signer non-repudiation.
